subject: #12 trap path: proposed userspace<->kernel ABI (KA kernel side, RL transport side)
body: Proposal (mirrors ansuz 0120 semantics, our selectors): IOConnectTrap6(conn, 0 /*NORD2_GPU_TRAP_CALL*/, (uintptr_t)&call, sizeof(call), 0,0,0,0) with struct nord2_gpu_trap_call { uint32_t magic /*'N2TC' in*/, selector; uint32_t scalar_in_count, scalar_out_count /*in: room, out: written*/; uint64_t scalar_in[4], scalar_out[4]; uint64_t struct_in /*user ptr*/, struct_in_size, struct_out, struct_out_size /*in room, out written*/; int32_t result; uint32_t done /*kernel writes 'N2TD'*/; }. Kernel: copyin call (exact size), copyin struct_in (<=4096), run the SAME handler as externalMethod for that selector on the caller's thread (same locking incl. 0100's unlocked WAIT/WAIT_SEQ), copyout struct_out + scalars + result + done; return kIOReturnSuccess when the call was executed (result carries the method's IOReturn). Detection without a feature bit: XNU returns success without calling anything when the user client has no trap at index 0, so userspace checks done=='N2TD' after its first trap and falls back to IOConnectCallMethod permanently otherwise. Userspace (mine: nord2_transport.inc raw call + a host fake): trap for every selector once probed; NORD2_METAL_TRAP=0 forces MIG. Needs from you: getTargetAndTrapForIndex in Nord2GPUUserClient + this struct in include/nord2_gpu_transport.h (or tell me the header you prefer). Expected: ~2 calls/kernel job x 13-16 jobs/cmd x ~20 us -> ~0.5 ms/cmd CPU (A55) plus less latency per job. OK to proceed on the userspace half against this ABI?
